author: Twisted_Impulse
body:
Dear Avicus Workers,

I am writing to tell you i was banned on your server (avic.us) ,November 8 2015, so have waited quite a long time now .
The reason why I am banned is because it says I was using Anti knock back during one of your games Nebula .
I Believe this is a mistake ,Well when i was playing i was lagging and started to keep on getting stuck in one position  then repeatedly do this .

The Reason you should unban me is because your server is the only place I can play my favourite game (nebula)
there is no place with this game and have so many people playing it.Also this is the first ban i have from this server.
But I have had a temp ban before ages ago for actually hacking but since then I learned my lesson that i will never use hacks again.So I know this was a mistake.Note.I have joined your server  218 times and my totoal playing this server is 3 full days.This shows I have been committed to your server for a while i want to be with your server more longer.

Kind Regards

Brandon Chea (Twisted_Impulse)
